svg.title: What the probe costs
svg.desc: For each benchmark document and engine, every build without prumo and every build with it (the probe and -recorder), as a difference from the median build without it.
svg.text: Builds with the probe and -recorder against builds without, in turns. 0 is the median without, the tick the median with.
